title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-30
source: Reel master > 1 cassette gen > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a monumental Kiel show highlighted by an epic 28‑minute Dark Star and an inspired Stella performance.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this tape is one of the best ’70s audience recordings available, noting its brilliant sound quality and immersive vibe. The concert itself is described as a “monumental night” with a 20–28 minute drippy Dark Star, a soaring Stella, and a slew of tight classics that make it a must‑hear for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are strongly positive (average 4.7★) and consistently praise both the performance (epic Dark Star, stellar set) and the audio quality (brilliant audience recording).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Repeatedly called a 'brilliant sounding' and 'best AUD' from the 70s; clear, immersive capture with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A 23‑song marathon described as a 'monumental night' with seamless flow and high energy throughout.
